evidence.explanation: JS currentLevel/waterHasKelp wrappers preserve the tested initialized-context terrain/Water exclusion and rn2 dispatch of the C predicate. This is selector behavior, not kelp object creation.
evidence.proof: 1,332 ordinary/Astral selector targets and666 Water controls: all37 terrain types, pool divisors0/2/10,moat0/3/30,both zero/max legal draws. Exact C water_has_kelp and real exported JS compare Boolean result and complete RNG bound sequences. The topology is generated by normal JS newgame_pre_mklev at fixed seed/date and copied as valid typed C dungeon inputs; C topology generation itself is not compared.
evidence.control: Water suppresses WATER terrain rolls while POOL and MOAT remain eligible to their respective divisors. Zero divisors suppress draws, and legal draw0 versus n-1 distinguishes success. No objects, invalid positions, negative direct divisors, runtime vegetation or independent RNG equivalence claim.

evidence.explanation: The port preflights initialized topology before the kelp scan and explicitly delegates C level predicates through context helpers. Within this valid no-resource domain it preserves gate outcomes and RNG consumption, including kelp-before-ordinary-exclusions and endgame-before-kelp.
evidence.proof: 924 normal targets and924 skip-level-check controls: all77 floors from the fixed initialized topology ×arboreal false/true ×ROOM-only or one3×3STONE island ×kelp parameters(0,0),(2,3),(-1,-1). Each map also has onePOOL,MOAT,WATER. Gold/gem probabilities0 and maximum legal kelp draws prevent every resource branch. Exact compiled C mineralize and dungeon predicates match real exported JS on complete RNG bound sequences.96 normal fixtures and462 bypass controls reach the mineral scan; remaining cases consume no mineral draws.
evidence.control: Bypass controls reach exactly two rn2(1000) calls when the stone island is present, regardless of exclusion flags; no-island controls never do. C resource constructors and non-rn2 random helpers abort if reached. This is not default gold/gem probability arithmetic, mineral quantity/type, resource allocation, placement, runtime behavior, map scan order beyond the observed RNG sequence, or all finalization. In_mines is qualified only for special-level eligibility and probability0, not its nonzero multiplier.
